description: The Bogotá Universidad Pedagógica tuition-free sit-in is body-confirmed, but the inspected report gives no demonstrator count. Its approximately 8,700 student population/beneficiary figure is not attendance.
required_followup: Find a contemporaneous attendance estimate or preserve pending_threshold.

description: Two February 12 Bogotá teacher-related sources remain search_only after receipt-reviewed web.open Cache/Internal Errors and ordinary HTTPS DNS failures. The captured titles do not verify execution or the reported group size. Additional search-only headlines refer to a teacher sit-in call and to the ADE/district education office; it is unresolved whether these describe public protests, planned actions or workplace occupations.
required_followup: Use an independently discovered contemporaneous accessible source, with a fresh exact-URL receipt and full publisher/origin review before any body attempt.

description: The Canal 1 gastrobar protest article S010 remains unread after a receipt-reviewed web.open Internal Error and a separate fresh-review HTTPS DNS failure. This is a technical retrieval gap, not an observed access denial.
required_followup: Seek another contemporaneous source for event execution, date, crowd size, demand and response; do not retry the same URL without a fresh receipt and review.

description: February 24 Bogotá search results identify a student march against police violence, reports of injuries/disturbances, and other groups’ actions. No source body was inspected for these reports and separate group attendance/coordination is unknown.
required_followup: Open contemporary reporting under the exact-URL access protocol; determine execution, threshold, protester violence, state responses, and whether student, recycler and environmental gatherings are distinct.

description: Search results surfaced a February 26 FECODE/CUT nationwide teacher-mobilization call and a La FM headline about a teachers’ sit-in to file petitions. The call is not proof of execution; local versus national event scope and attendance are unresolved.
required_followup: Verify contemporaneous execution, participating locations, state target, attendance, organizer and any continuation without automatically splitting a national action by city.

description: OACEP’s retrospective bulletin was opened only for pages 0–11, covering methodology and annual aggregates, not event-level chronology. Search results also point to a February 15 Bogotá teacher march whose underlying citation has not been located. A February 2021 Medellín civic bulletin (S026) and another OACEP bulletin (S027) were captured as local/retrospective leads but remain unread.
required_followup: Review the exact event-level retrospective pages and locate the underlying contemporaneous account before adding a teacher-march candidate.

description: The first pass found no verified start-before-February continuation or end date for either body-read candidate. Search coverage near January and March is incomplete; later announcements or outcomes cannot be assigned to February without event-specific evidence.
required_followup: Check January and March contemporaneous coverage and official follow-up for repeated university actions, physical closure and cross-month continuity.

description: This is a bounded open-web first pass, not an exhaustive census or a LexisNexis-equivalent search. The search set covered all four weekly windows, Spanish and English terms, Bogotá and several named regions, student, teacher, business, recycler and environmental leads, plus retrospective/official sources. Search-result counts and access failures do not measure event absence.
required_followup: A later review should add local/regional outlet archives across all departments, accessible contemporaneous source bodies, and systematic retrospective/newspaper archive coverage.
